fluff.overview: Reforms begun under Alessandro Steiner and reinforced by Federated Suns influence have integrated Lyran infantry into combined-arms operations more effectively than at any point in the Commonwealth's history. Jump infantry use thruster backpacks to leap across obstacles and reposition rapidly on the battlefield, trading platoon size for the tactical mobility to seize or defend terrain that foot troops cannot reach quickly. Equipped with Maxell PL-10 laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the more effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
